About Us The Calhoun County Elections Specialist works in the County Clerk's Marshall Office, which is located at 315 W Green St., in Marshall, Mich. Regular Office hours are Monday-Thursday 8 a.m.-5 p.m., and Friday 8 a.m.-Noon. Core Values The Calhoun County Clerks and Register of Deeds Office is committed to a fair election process, providing leadership and support to clerks countywide.
